log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Only ever kill national plus the WEB and UNION sources. Never touch regional, court, foreign or medical. Exposing two 30% sources gives at most 0.3*0.3 = 9%, about 900k people, and about 540k after 5% police trimming per conference, which stays safe above 300k. A third source would drop the pool below 300k, so never add one. TIMING SAFETY: at most 4 kills a day. That is 2 QUICK in the afternoon plus 2 TIMED, one in the evening and one at night. This way no routine is busy during more than 2 deaths, so timing reveals nothing. Each day kill: national-1 (timed evening), web-1 (timed night), web-2 (quick afternoon), union-1 (quick afternoon). Alternate the union/web choice if you like, but stay within web+union. If a press conference warns of new records, stay the course; the plan already assumes every source is traced. If an announced pool ever reads 300k or less, consider cutting to national only.
